source: Afenda brand guideline local source files promoted into public SVG assets.
note: Current lynx source master is raster artwork embedded in SVG containers to preserve exact approved geometry. Replace internals only after a true vector master is approved; keep filenames stable.

lynx.purpose: Canonical Afenda lynx observer mark for product chrome, app tiles, favicon, mono production, and compact identity placements.
lynx.rule: Use through AppLogo placement semantics in frontend code. Do not redraw the lynx, beads, or field.

typography.purpose: Afenda wordmark and typography lockup for editorial, deck, documentation, and partner brand surfaces where the lynx mark is already present or intentionally omitted.
typography.rule: Do not use as a functional UI icon. Do not use as the source for lynx/bead artwork.

combined.purpose: Wide Afenda lockups that combine the approved public lynx variants with the typography lockup for brand boards, presentations, docs, and controlled marketing surfaces.
combined.rule: The lynx side of each combined asset is embedded from public/brand/afenda lynx assets. Do not derive the lynx from typography proposal artwork because the beads are hidden there.
